status: v2 Apple-inspired restrained elevation: white/black content, gray chrome, blue folder/selection emphasis; shadows only on truly floating layers

z0.use: white (light) or true black (dark) content canvas; chrome sits directly on it

z1.use: titlebar/sidebar; separated by its neutral background, not a shadow

z2.use: main content surface; almost flat, only a hairline of depth

z3.use: selected identity surface, active navigation row, menus, task panel

motion.selected: 180ms ease-out; raise identity surface, filename turns accent blue
motion.reduced_motion: no animation; final elevation/color state only

limits.no_outline: no border or stroke communicates hierarchy, selection, focus or hover
limits.no_gray_wash: gray chrome is not extended to content surfaces or folder identity
limits.file_types: file-type icons keep their identification colors in both modes
